reason: The free first visit and the gated Baby Nook with limited headcount make it worth trying on a Saturday. If it feels calm and my baby is not getting steamrolled, I would come back once or twice.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? Money is tight after daycare went up, and $15 every Saturday adds up fast.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the Baby Nook in person and confirming it really is separated and the cap on kids is real; a weekend price nearer $10 would make it a habit.
